projects.name: Weightlifting App
projects.meta: iOS · on the App Store since 2017
projects.description: The workout log I have kept on the App Store since 2017 and still use for every session. It tracks sets, estimates one-rep maxes, and turns progress into levels, achievements, and a leaderboard. Every number in the Weightlifting section of this site comes out of it.

projects.name: Homework App
projects.meta: iOS · acquired by Haystack AI in 2019
projects.description: Built in high school to keep track of my own assignments. It grew into the #1 homework app on the App Store, with 338k installs and 63k monthly users, and Haystack AI acquired it in 2019.

projects.name: meta-kb
projects.description: A wiki about LLM agent infrastructure that an LLM compiles from 126 raw sources and then audits against them. Each pass extracts atomic claims, checks every one against its cited source, and rewrites its own prompts from what failed. Three rounds took claim accuracy from 64% to 80%. Fork it and point it at any topic.

projects.name: This website
projects.description: The site you are reading, as a public repo. Next.js and tRPC over Postgres, with a three.js room for a homepage. Book notes sync from Notion, training data from Weightlifting App, and the YouTube diet from Takeout exports. Most other sections are JSON files.

projects.name: Liar's Dice
projects.description: A calculator for Liar's Dice. Enter your hand, the dice on the table, and the current bid, and it gives the probability of every possible call so you can decide whether to raise or challenge. The odds are exact. Reading the other players is still on you.
